verdict.rationale: No dedicated export feature is documented. Data can be pulled indirectly: the API lists project issues, paid tiers include API access, and sentry-cli can view and stream logs. The documented self-hosted option, which runs all of Sentry on your own server, lets users keep their data under their own control and lowers lock-in. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open or standard export formats, migration or exit guidance covering all data types (events, traces, replays, dashboards), and independent hands-on confirmation of a complete export.
